answer: Permission tiers in this economy open like an ivory keyhouse, each door turning only after small, real trades: buy, deliver, get rated. Privileges drip out slowly, the way an oasis gives nectar one measured pour at a time, always against settled commerce. A sybil ring can fake statements cheaply, but every unlocked right demands paid counterparties, so manufacturing a thousand eligible identities means paying a thousand genuine markets — the clone inherits the bill, never the history.
